title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Starting a New Hobby 😂 ADHD Hobby Hopping #shorts
desc:
ADHD hobby hopping: all in on Friday, done by Sunday.

Bought the guitar, the amp and 3 books. Played it once. It lives in the closet with the other 9 hobbies. 😂 What's in YOUR hobby graveyard? 👇

Tip: try a new hobby for free for two weeks before you buy the gear.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdhobbies #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny
tags: what it's like to have adhd

beats.say: Here's how a normal person starts a hobby. Try it. Like it. Keep doing it.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:
beats.cap: Try it. Like it. Keep it.

beats.say: Now here's me. Friday night. I watched one video. I'm a guitar person now.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Guitar. Amp. Strap. Picks in six colors. Three books. Next day shipping.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Saturday. Six hours of lessons. I learned one chord. I'm basically famous.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Sunday. My fingers hurt. This is hard. Ooh. Somebody's making pottery.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: The guitar lives in the closet now. Next to the paint set. And the skateboard. And the bread starter.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: But pottery is different. This time it's for real.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's why. An ADHD brain gets a big rush from anything new, and the rush fades once it gets hard. So try it for free for two weeks before you buy the gear.
beats.cap2: Tip: two free weeks before you buy the gear.

beats.say: What's in your hobby closet? Tell me in the comments.
